Features  Practical Design of 3pcs Handbag  This women's handbag features an adjustable wide shoulder strap, the length of which can be adjusted as needed, and can be used as a crossbody bag, shoulder bag, or handbag. It's a versatile accessory that easily handles various occasions from weekdays to weekends.
 Internal Structure:  Large Handbag: 1 large compartment, 1 internal zip pocket, 2 slip pockets, and 1 external zip pocket  1 snap purse and 1 card holder, perfect for dates, shopping, work, travel, vacations, parties, and other occasions, keeping your everyday items organized.
 Pure Material  Stylish and environmentally friendly, ideal for your everyday use.
 Specifications  Name: 3pcs Handbag  Colors: Coffee, White with Tan, Pink with Black, Coffee with Tan, White with Black, Pink  Material: PU Leather
 Package List  1 x 3pcs Handbag
 Warm Tips:  1. A slight odor is normal and will disappear after a few days.  2. As measurements are taken manually, there may be a 1-2 cm error in size.  3. Due to differences in monitors or lighting conditions, there may be slight color variations. Please understand.

[ Perfect Size ] The leather handbags for women measures 11.2 inches (L) x 4.1 inches (W) x 8.1 inches (H), with a handle height of 5.3 inches and an adjustable shoulder strap that extends up to 46.5 inches

[Versatile Use] Handbags for women easily holds a 10-inch iPad, iPhone, keys, credit cards, ID card, passport, cosmetics, lipstick, and a mirror. Perfect for business meetings or weekend relaxation, purses for women its elegant design ensures you always look your best and is incredibly versatile
